settings.q: Can I choose the number and the words it's made from?

settings.q: Can you produce a full set (1st, 2nd, 3rd)?
settings.a: Yes, we regularly produce matched ranking sets for awards programmes and events.

settings.hero_desc: A bold 3D typographic award where the trophy itself is built from words - the ranking number formed entirely of the names, values and achievements that matter to the recipient. 3D-printed, hand-finished and mounted on a solid base. A modern, meaningful alternative to the standard cup.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your number/shape and the exact words to build it from
settings.s1_body: Most trophies say the same thing. This one is different: the number is sculpted from the very words you want to celebrate - the winner's name, the project, the values, the milestone. We design the typography, 3D-print it, and finish it on a clean base so the message reads from every angle. Ideal for corporate awards, rankings and recognition where the story matters as much as the win.
settings.case_body: Produced for an event company whose client wanted a unique way to give awards. They send us the typography PDF which we then converted into a 3D Typography award.
settings.case_quote: Everyone wanted to read theirs up close. It made the recognition feel personal.
settings.prov_p: By turning words into form, the award carries its message in its very shape - a modern take on recognition that feels designed, not bought off a shelf. The message is the trophy.
